name: Della Resorts Lonavala
why_special: India's largest adventure-led resort across 90 acres in Tungarli — over 60 adventure activities including a Sky Bar at 65 ft, Zorbing, and the country's only suspended fine-dining restaurant. The Lonavala destination resort for weekend Mumbai/Pune families.

name: Fariyas Resort Lonavala
why_special: Fariyas Group's flagship Tungarli hill resort with one of Lonavala's longest pools — indoor games, multi-cuisine restaurant. The senior 4-star pick before Della arrived; still the better choice when adventure isn't the agenda.

name: Rhythm Lonavala
why_special: All-suite boutique resort with one-bedroom and family suites — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the Lonavala all-suite pick on the Pawna lake side. Better-sized rooms than Fariyas at similar pricing.

name: Hilton Shillim Estate Retreat & Spa
why_special: Hilton-managed 320-acre wellness retreat in the Shillim Valley 45 min from Lonavala — Ayurveda spa across 12,000 sq m, 100+ rooms in heritage cottages, the South-Asian destination wellness resort. The Lonavala-adjacent splurge when wellness beats adventure.
